description: Rotate selected pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise (-90 = counter-clockwise), on top of any rotation they already have. Other pages, links and form fields are left as they are. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-organizer/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

pages.description: Pages to rotate: 1-based list like "1-3, 5, 8-" ("5-" = to the end, "-3" = first three, "3-1" = reversed). Also "all", "odd", "even", "last". Empty = all pages.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: pdf_rotate
title: Rotate PDF pages
